producerConfig.run_name: TJLABS SOFTWARE FIXTURE — NOT A TONIC EVALUATION

limitations: Authored software receiving input; timestamps are fixture metadata, not an observed evaluation.
Every numeric value is the exact original JSON number lexeme; no metric or aggregate is calculated.
Per-character groups can overlap. File-kind message/document rollups overlap their component groups. Do not sum these rows.
Generated-gold native recall is distinct from precision/F1 on exhaustive human annotations. This profile does not import run_ner_eval output.
Protocol v1 and v2 datasets are not interchangeable. Dataset revision, native matcher threshold, labels and judge configuration travel with each candidate.
Benchmark data is synthetic; the original vendor results do not prove production privacy, regulatory compliance or customer acceptance.
Original table values are not recalculated. Review source cohort, period, denominator, units and mapping before judging comparability.

metrics.label: gold
metrics.definition: Original count of in-scope gold spans in this group.

metrics.label: detected
metrics.definition: Original count of gold spans detected with the matching entity label and native-coordinate overlap.

metrics.label: coherent
metrics.definition: Original count of detected gold spans with a changed replacement judged coherent.

metrics.label: incoherent
metrics.definition: Original count of detected gold spans left identical or judged incoherent.

metrics.label: skipped
metrics.definition: Original count of detected changed spans lacking a usable judge verdict; these remain in the detected denominator.

metrics.label: ner_recall
metrics.definition: Original detected/gold rate. Detection requires the producer label and native-coordinate overlap contract.

metrics.label: synthesis_accuracy
metrics.definition: Original coherent/detected rate. Identity mappings and unjudged detected spans do not become successful synthesis.

metrics.label: combined_accuracy
metrics.definition: Original coherent/gold rate. This includes detection misses in its original gold-span denominator.
